title: Lifecycle IR common definitions
description: Identifier grammars and shared value objects for the five Lifecycle IR structures. Every node in a bundle carries an identifier of the form <kind>:<slug>; the kind prefix is what makes a cross-structure reference typed, so a reference field can declare which kinds it accepts and the validator can enforce it.

irVersion.description: Version of the IR specification a document conforms to.

changeRequest.description: Identifier of the change request this bundle expresses.

checkRef.description: Reference to an executable check held in bench/. The check itself is never part of the IR: the IR records that a clause is discharged by that check, not the check's contents.

intentSubjectId.description: A goal, behavior or acceptance condition: the intent nodes other structures are allowed to point at.

intentClauseId.description: A behavior or acceptance condition: the intent nodes a transformation claims to implement and evidence claims to discharge.

obligationTargetId.description: An intent clause or a constraint: the two things evidence can discharge.

transformationId.description: A code change or a deployment change.

nodeId.description: Any addressable node in a bundle.

artifact.description: An external artifact referenced by the IR, identified by location and content hash.
